name: pixels
description: Pixels - a browser-based 3D multiplayer town with an AI guide

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @pixels/server" "npm run dev -w @pixels/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pixels/web && npm run build -w @pixels/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pixels/shared && npm run test -w @pixels/server && npm run test -w @pixels/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pixels/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pixels/server && npm run typecheck -w @pixels/web
